{{Quote|What kind of name is Darkwalker for a criminal organization? I must speak with my superiors about this. A change is in order. Something more businesslike and less spooky.|Jorgellansel|<ref name="SWG:DDD" />}}
'''Jorgellansel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was an [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] of the [[Darkwalkers]] gang. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was based in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] where he was tasked to blackmail [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]], the father of the indebted [[Karl Eckener|Karl]].<ref name="SWG:DDD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jorgellansel ordered Hugo Eckener to hire a spacer in order to attack [[Borvo Bunker]]<ref name="SWG:EHB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Everyone Hates Borvo|Naboo}}</ref> and the [[Skaak Tipper Compound]].<ref name="SWG:DDD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorgellansel appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DDD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jorgellansel was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
